help.amountReceived: How much money you received in total. When you type it, the money is split across the bills with the oldest due dates first and fills the Pay boxes; or leave it empty and fill each box yourself.
help.pay: How much money goes on this bill. Pay and discount together cannot be more than what is due on the bill.
help.discount: A one-off discount on this bill. Any discount needs an admin's approval when you submit.
help.walletUse: Tick to deduct from the student's earlier credit balance: the smaller of the credit balance and the subtotal comes off; credit balance cannot be used when paying for several students.
help.method: How you received the money. Only with cash can you take more than the amount due and give change.
help.reference: The transaction number for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, bank, cheque or card; this box is not shown for cash.
help.tendered: Cash only: how much the payer handed over. Used to work out the change; you can leave it empty. If it falls short of the amount due after credit balance, you cannot submit.
help.changeHandling: Whether to give the change back in hand or keep it as the student's credit balance. It can be kept as credit only when the payment is for one student.
help.remarks: A note for yourselves, for example who dropped off the money.
help.reverseReason: Why you are reversing the payment; 3 to 500 characters. The reversal entry and the credit note carry this reason.
help.includeReversed: Off: a payment that was reversed is hidden. On: reversed payments and the reversal entries show too, marked Reversed and Reversal entry.
